crossRefs.note: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,
but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

translations.web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
translations.bsb: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
translations.kjv: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
translations.asv: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer. Psalm 20 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
